_comment: Right-click context help. Transcribed from ERICHELP::_new_game_screen_help_list (erichelp.cpp:27), installed by NEWGAME::Newgame_Screen_ (newgame.cpp:77). The original's help rectangles are wider than its click fields — {546, 99,84,212,226} covers the Difficulty picture AND its label, while field 1 is only the picture. HD resolves each region from the cover-scaled slot in layout.json, which is the same whole-control area. The screen-wide entry 545 must stay last: the walk stops at the first hit, so a fallback listed earlier would eat every other region.
